screens.name: Home
screens.evidence: Sheet 08 shows settled and transition Home with a dominant gold orb, example question, entertainment disclaimer and unavailable omen.
findings: Give the unavailable omen a clearer recovery route or explain why retry must wait until tomorrow.

screens.name: Approach
screens.evidence: Sheet 01 shows consistent orb and message placement across approach captures, with automatic advance and reduced-motion bypass reported.
findings: Verify that the brief automatic transition does not interrupt focus or announcements on assistive technology.

screens.name: Ask
screens.evidence: Sheet 02 shows a labeled multiline question, typing and voice paths, and stable transition geometry.
findings: Replace the implementation-oriented phrase 'your prediction engine' with a plain explanation of where questions are sent.

screens.name: Ask — enlarged
screens.evidence: Sheet 01 shows enlarged question text and stacked actions without visible text truncation, while runtime evidence reports responsive layout checks.
findings: Verify submission and question visibility with a physical mobile keyboard and native text enlargement.

screens.name: Listening — voice unavailable
screens.evidence: Sheet 09 clearly elevates typing above retrying voice and displays a microphone recovery notice in both captures.
findings: Verify that the failure notice is announced and that focus reaches the typing fallback on a real device.

screens.name: Planning — loading
screens.evidence: Sheet 11 names the current operation, gives a wait expectation and credit reassurance, and exposes Cancel.
findings: Verify announcement of the loading state and cancellation outcome with a screen reader.

screens.name: Question 1 — choices
screens.evidence: Sheet 02 presents four spacious choices and step progress, while supplied keyboard evidence reports activation, focus transfer and Back restoration.
findings: Verify that immediate advancement announces the new question reliably on native assistive technology.

screens.name: Question 2 — choices
screens.evidence: Sheet 03 preserves question, option and progress alignment across its transition and settled captures.
findings: Verify that Back communicates the restored choice through both visible and spoken selection state.

screens.name: Question 3 — choices
screens.evidence: Sheet 03 shows the final step using the same spacious choice structure and continuous visual treatment.
findings: Make the final answer's immediate transition into prediction generation predictable to first-time users.

screens.name: Answer — keyboard focus
screens.evidence: Sheet 01 visibly outlines the newly focused question heading, and supplied evidence reports that Tab then reaches the first answer.
findings: Use a consistent high-contrast focus treatment across question headings and settings controls.

screens.name: Custom answer — empty
screens.evidence: Sheet 04 shows the question, Your answer label, Change action, empty multiline input and disabled Continue across matched captures.
findings: Add a short required-answer cue so the disabled Continue state explains how to proceed.

screens.name: Custom answer — enlarged empty
screens.evidence: Sheet 04 retains the full enlarged question, input and disabled submission control within the visible viewport.
findings: Keep the required-answer explanation readable at enlarged size without pushing submission below the keyboard.

screens.name: Custom answer — enlarged filled
screens.evidence: Sheet 05 shows retained answer text and a prominent multiline Reveal my prediction button, supported by reported preservation and submission checks.
findings: Verify the enlarged multiline button and retained answer with native text scaling.

screens.name: Custom answer — synthetic keyboard viewport
screens.evidence: Sheet 05 keeps the entered text and submission visible but does not show the question context, despite reported context retention in the synthetic viewport test.
findings: Capture and verify how users recover the question and Change action while a physical keyboard is open.

screens.name: Research — loading
screens.evidence: Sheet 11 distinguishes prediction research through explanatory text while preserving the loading layout, cancellation and credit reassurance.
findings: Announce the change from question checking to prediction research without repeatedly reading decorative content.

screens.name: Plan error
screens.evidence: Sheet 06 shows a clear failure, no-charge reassurance, prominent retry and an edit-question alternative using explicitly labeled fixture text.
findings: Verify that retry failure preserves the question and announces the renewed error on assistive technology.

screens.name: Prediction error
screens.evidence: Sheet 06 adds Review answers to retry and edit recovery, with visually stable transition and settled layouts.
findings: Verify that every recovery route preserves completed answers and returns focus to the relevant context.

screens.name: Sensitive question — planning redirect
screens.evidence: Sheet 13 separates support, another question and editing, and explicitly states that no reading or memory was spent.
findings: Give the support destination stronger emphasis when seeking support is the intended next step.

screens.name: Sensitive question — prediction redirect
screens.evidence: Sheet 13 preserves the same redirect structure after prediction processing, and the supplied runtime narrative reports a real sensitive redirect.
findings: Verify focus and support-link destination behavior after a redirect from the later processing stage.

screens.name: Reveal
screens.evidence: Sheet 12 gives the forecast strong emphasis and supplies uncertainty, explanation, date and follow-up actions, while its transition briefly dims the forecast.
findings: Reduce the secondary-action cluster and verify that the fading forecast remains readable throughout its entrance.

screens.name: Reveal — explanation expanded
screens.evidence: Sheet 12 exposes the explanation under a clear disclosure state but gives most initial viewport space to the orb and forecast.
findings: Bring the expanded explanation into view and structure long explanations into readable sections.

screens.name: Check-in — unselected
screens.evidence: Sheets 04–05 place three outcome actions below the prediction while retaining a future Check back date and a prominent share action.
findings: Clarify whether this is an early outcome update or a due check-in when the displayed date is still in the future.

screens.name: Check-in — Yes saved
screens.evidence: Sheet 10 shows a checkmark, inline saved status and confirmation notice, and runtime evidence reports actual persistence after reload.
findings: Keep the inline confirmation authoritative and prevent the supplementary notice from covering needed actions.

screens.name: Check-in — Not quite saved
screens.evidence: Sheet 09 marks Not quite as selected but describes the stored outcome as Didn't come true, with real UI persistence reported.
findings: Use the same outcome wording in the choice, saved status and history so partial success is not recast as failure.

screens.name: Check-in — Not yet saved
screens.evidence: Sheet 09 shows a checked Not yet option, matching inline saved state and a waiting confirmation supported by reported reload persistence.
findings: Verify that the saved pending state is announced once without duplicate live-region messages.

screens.name: History — empty
screens.evidence: Sheet 08 pairs a clear empty-state message with Ask the Ball and explicitly identifies storage as device-local.
findings: Verify the text-only Ask the Ball action has a full touch target and a clear focus state.

screens.name: History — populated
screens.evidence: Sheet 07 separates date, original question, forecast and check-back date, with persistence reported in the runtime evidence.
findings: Use a reader-friendly localized check-back date instead of the raw ISO presentation.

screens.name: History — stress list
screens.evidence: Sheet 07 shows repeated history rows with a further entry continuing behind the fixed navigation region.
findings: Verify that the final row can scroll fully above the raised Ask orb and fixed tab bar.

screens.name: History — saved outcome
screens.evidence: Sheet 07 displays a checkmarked Came true result in history, backed by reported use of actual save controls and storage.
findings: Expose the outcome as part of the row's accessible description and preserve matching terminology across views.

screens.name: Sky — offline sample stars
screens.evidence: Sheet 15 discloses offline sample content, marks Love with a checkmark and places Ask this too close to the raised navigation area.
findings: Increase bottom clearance around Ask this too and verify generous hit areas and focus order for every star.

screens.name: Circles — offline empty
screens.evidence: Sheet 05 explains sharing boundaries and offline status, offers Retry and visibly disables creation and the friends preference.
findings: Place a concise reason next to each disabled control so offline restrictions and age restrictions remain distinguishable.

screens.name: Plans
screens.evidence: Sheet 10 clearly labels simulation, yearly selection and billing terms, but the settled capture shows the decorative orb clipped at the upper edge.
findings: Verify initial scroll positioning and remove incidental orb clipping from the settled entry state.

screens.name: Plans — enlarged
screens.evidence: Sheet 10 stacks enlarged plan names, billing terms, prices and the simulated purchase action without visible horizontal truncation.
findings: Verify that remaining pack options and dismissal stay reachable with native enlargement and screen-reader navigation.

screens.name: You — empty memory and settings
screens.evidence: Sheets 14 and 16 show plan details, an explained empty memory state and labeled preferences supported by reported keyboard and persistence checks.
findings: Make the relationship between See plans and View plans and credits clearer or consolidate the duplicate routes.

screens.name: You — populated memory
screens.evidence: Sheet 16 presents three labeled facts with Edit and Forget, and supplied real-flow evidence reports editing, forgetting and Undo.
findings: Give repeated Edit and Forget controls accessible names that include the associated fact.

screens.name: Settings — enlarged
screens.evidence: Sheet 14 shows enlarged preference labels, a visibly selected large-text switch and wrapping settings actions above the fixed navigation.
findings: Verify the last settings action can scroll clear of navigation at native enlarged text sizes.

screens.name: Settings — keyboard focus
screens.evidence: Sheet 14 shows a full-row focus outline, and supplied controls evidence reports 342×52px targets with label, Space and Enter activation.
findings: Verify spoken switch names and states on VoiceOver and TalkBack.

screens.name: Share
screens.evidence: Sheets 14–15 show a portrait preview and image, video and private-link choices, while supplied evidence establishes PNG export but not every displayed delivery path.
findings: Make availability explicit for video and private links until those paths have demonstrated end-to-end results.

screens.name: Story preview and export
screens.evidence: Sheets 15–16 show a coherent portrait card and export action, supported by reported real PNG generation and injected export-failure recovery.
findings: Verify text legibility in the exported image at typical social viewing size and confirm actual OS delivery separately.

components.name: Hero orb
components.evidence: The illustrated orb consistently anchors the sheets, and supplied motion evidence reports browser frame checks and stopped drawing under reduced motion.
findings: Preserve the orb's prominence while verifying an explicit accessible action name wherever it is interactive.

components.name: Tab bar
components.evidence: The five labeled destinations use gold active styling and a raised central orb, with small captions that remain small in enlarged screenshots.
findings: Improve enlarged-text support for tab labels and verify content clearance around the raised Ask control.

components.name: Wordmark and balance header
components.evidence: Headers consistently pair a restrained title or wordmark with a right-aligned daily balance that changes across reading states.
findings: Label the balance as readings remaining so its unit is understandable outside the main asking flow.

components.name: Primary button
components.evidence: Cream filled buttons consistently identify primary actions, wrap enlarged labels and visibly distinguish enabled from disabled states.
findings: Verify pressed and focused states across all primary actions and keep disabled-state explanations adjacent.

components.name: Secondary action
components.evidence: Gold text actions recur consistently, but dense clusters appear below reveal and several small utility links lack visible target boundaries.
findings: Group secondary actions by purpose and verify 44pt targets without relying on the text's visible bounds.

components.name: Answer choice
components.evidence: Question screens use spacious divider-separated choices, with supplied evidence for keyboard activation, immediate advance and restored answers.
findings: Verify visible restored selection and spoken state after returning to a previously answered question.

components.name: Question input
components.evidence: Ask screenshots show a labeled serif multiline field with an outer gold border and an additional bottom rule.
findings: Simplify the competing field rules while retaining a distinct keyboard focus indicator.

components.name: Large-text input
components.evidence: Enlarged forms retain multiline text and visible submission, but the synthetic keyboard capture omits the surrounding question context.
findings: Verify physical keyboard scrolling preserves access to the prompt, Change action and full submit control.

components.name: Settings switch
components.evidence: Sheet 14 shows labeled switches, a selected state and full-row focus, supported by reported target-size, keyboard and persistence checks.
findings: Confirm native assistive technology announces each switch's name and changed state.

components.name: Omen content
components.evidence: Home shows an explicitly unavailable free omen and instructs users to try tomorrow without a visible immediate recovery action.
findings: Explain the wait or provide retry when the failure is recoverable within the current day.

components.name: Sky stars and selected question
components.evidence: Sheet 15 uses labeled stars, a checkmarked selected category and a matching sample question with an action near bottom navigation.
findings: Verify star hit areas and logical focus order, and reserve clear space for the selected question's action.

components.name: Circle surface
components.evidence: Sheet 05 provides an offline notice, retry, sharing boundaries and disabled creation within the borderless surface.
findings: Tie each disabled control to its specific restriction with adjacent explanatory text.

components.name: History row
components.evidence: Sheet 07 groups date, question, forecast and either check-back date or saved outcome using quiet separators.
findings: Use localized dates and verify each row has a concise accessible name including outcome status.

components.name: Plan option
components.evidence: Sheet 10 visibly marks the yearly selection, exposes annual billing and monthly equivalents, and stacks enlarged pricing.
findings: Verify radio-style selection semantics and announcements for both billing choices.

components.name: Share preview
components.evidence: The share thumbnail and larger story card preserve the forecast and uncertainty label, with actual PNG generation reported.
findings: Increase small disclaimer legibility at typical viewing size and provide a text equivalent for the exported card.

components.name: Notice and recovery
components.evidence: Voice and outcome notices show explicit messages and dismissal, while supplied evidence reports inline live statuses and error recovery.
findings: Verify notices announce once and do not obscure controls needed to continue or recover.

components.name: Typography and spacing
components.evidence: The sheets consistently separate serif questions and forecasts from sans-serif controls, with enlarged examples but small metadata and navigation captions.
findings: Increase the smallest utility text and verify its contrast over the lightest mist regions.

components.name: Atmospheric background
components.evidence: Dark mist and restrained gold illumination remain coherent across screens, with supplied browser evidence for reduced-motion cessation and sustained rendering.
findings: Verify worst-frame text contrast and motion comfort on physical phones before extending browser findings to native use.

limitations: All grades are provisional: assessment uses the attached screenshots and supplied runtime narrative, without independent execution or inspection of underlying reports.

For each item, A is the mean of hierarchy, typography and surfaces; F is the mean of clarity, feedback and accessibility; overall is round(0.4A + 0.6F, 1), excluding genuinely inapplicable null dimensions.
The authorized A >=9 and F >=9 threshold is not met; neither these screenshots nor the supplied browser evidence permits 9/10 certification.
No confirmed hard-gate failure is established, but cropped controls and keyboard-context visibility require live verification before ruling out reachability failures.
Transition pairs support visual comparisons, not complete animation continuity, transient legibility, focus timing or absence of distracting shifts.
Reported layout checks cover 360/390/430 widths and normal/200% text; complete before/action/after evidence at every boundary is not independently available here.
Physical iPhone Safari, native Dynamic Type, physical keyboard safe areas, VoiceOver/TalkBack, microphone hardware and native haptics remain unverified.
Payments are simulated, social infrastructure is unavailable, and OS share delivery is unverified; screenshots do not establish the operation of every displayed sharing option.
Synthetic forecast and explanation wording is layout evidence only and is not treated as a production-copy defect or evidence of predictive quality.
No repeated novice-use study, representative physical accessibility study or all-domain semantic-quality evidence is supplied.
topFixes: Verify and correct bottom clearance for Sky actions and scrolling content around the raised Ask orb and fixed navigation.
Resolve the keyboard-context evidence gap on a physical phone with enlarged text and the real keyboard open.
Keep outcome terminology consistent: Not quite should not silently become Didn't come true.
Improve small navigation captions, metadata and share-card disclaimers, then measure contrast across animated backgrounds.
Clarify recovery for the unavailable omen and distinguish why each offline or age-restricted control is disabled.
Complete physical assistive-technology, native text-scaling and delivery checks before considering 9/10 certification.
